projects.title: Nexus Stream: High-Throughput Event Mesh
projects.shortDescription: Distributed real-time event broker processing 180k msgs/sec with sub-5ms p99 latency across multi-region Kubernetes clusters.
projects.problemStatement: Legacy monolithic message queues collapsed under bursty peak loads (>150k TPS), causing consumer lag of over 45 seconds and inconsistent ordering during node failover.
projects.solutionOverview: Engineered a partition-aware event distribution gateway with raft-backed consensus, zero-copy buffer pools in Go/Rust, and partitioned Kafka topic replication with automated backpressure telemetry.
projects.architectureOverview: Edge ingest reverse proxies terminate TLS and route gRPC streaming traffic directly into memory-mapped ring buffers before multi-AZ persistence and push-based SSE/WebSocket delivery.
keyFeatures: Zero-copy serialization with Protocol Buffers and custom ring-buffer queues
Dynamic backpressure propagation preventing downstream consumer starvation
Multi-tenant isolation with adaptive rate limiters and cryptographic token verification
Real-time observability export via Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and Grafana dashboards
projects.personalContribution: Lead Architect: Designed core raft quorum protocol, implemented zero-copy ring buffers in Go, and oversaw live migration with 99.999% uptime.
verifiedOutcomes: Reduced p99 ingestion latency from 85ms to 4.2ms
Cut monthly cloud compute costs by 42% ($38,000/mo reduction)
Maintained zero message loss across 3 simulated region failure drills
projects.challengesLearned: Handling TCP socket starvation required tuning Linux kernel epoll buffers and socket reuse flags (`SO_REUSEPORT`).

projects.title: Aurora Core: Double-Entry Immutable Ledger
projects.shortDescription: Financial transaction engine supporting strict ACID guarantees, cryptographic audit trails, and multi-currency exchange balancing.
projects.problemStatement: Legacy financial system relied on single-entry balance rows that periodically drifted during race conditions, requiring manual reconciliation at end of day.
projects.solutionOverview: Constructed an immutable, append-only double-entry ledger in PostgreSQL with strict constraints, optimistic locking, and a Next.js administrative treasury portal.
projects.architectureOverview: Next.js App Router admin interface connects to a hardened transaction processor API with isolation-level serializable transactions and cryptographic hash chaining per account block.
keyFeatures: Strict double-entry accounting with balanced credit/debit constraint assertions
Cryptographic SHA-256 block chaining guaranteeing tamper-evident audit records
Sub-millisecond ledger queries with customized B-tree and composite indexing
Comprehensive admin reconciliation studio with simulated multi-currency stress testing
projects.personalContribution: Sole author of core SQL migration schema, transaction locking strategy, and full-stack administration dashboard.
verifiedOutcomes: Eliminated 100% of balance discrepancies across 14M transactions
Passed SOC2 Type II compliance audit with zero discrepancies
Enabled audited real-time settlement in under 120ms
projects.challengesLearned: Preventing deadlocks under concurrent debit/credit requests required deterministic account ID sorting before acquiring row-level locks.

projects.title: Chronos: Distributed Cron & Workflow Orchestration
projects.shortDescription: Fault-tolerant cron scheduler executing over 1.2M automated batch jobs daily with exactly-once execution guarantees.
projects.problemStatement: Periodic batch tasks were handled by server-local crontabs that failed silently during AWS instance reboots, causing missed data warehouse aggregations and duplicate billing triggers.
projects.solutionOverview: Constructed a leader-elected scheduler daemon using Etcd leases, distributed lock fencing tokens, and automated heartbeat retries across worker pools.
projects.architectureOverview: Etcd election assigns master duties for dispatching job tasks into priority queues. Worker nodes acquire fencing tokens before executing jobs to avoid split-brain execution.
keyFeatures: Leader election and auto-failover via Etcd v3 distributed leases
Fencing token validation preventing zombie workers from modifying state
Dynamic cron expression parser with timezone-aware execution offsets
Dead-letter queues with exponential backoff and Slack alerting webhooks
projects.personalContribution: Designed fault-tolerance semantics, authored worker execution agent, and implemented web-based execution graph monitor.
verifiedOutcomes: Processed 1.2M jobs daily with 0 duplicate executions
Cut incident triage time from 2 hours to under 3 minutes with unified job tracing
projects.challengesLearned: Network partitions could allow stale leaders to dispatch work. Solving this required monotonic fencing tokens validated by recipient services.

projects.title: Synapse: Semantic Vector RAG & Governance Engine
projects.shortDescription: Enterprise LLM retrieval-augmented generation gateway with streaming latency optimization, PII sanitization, and vector cache.
projects.problemStatement: Internal teams faced high LLM inference costs and unverified hallucinations due to poor context chunking and duplicate semantic queries.
projects.solutionOverview: Architected a unified RAG proxy with hybrid dense-sparse vector search, semantic caching, and streaming token delivery with real-time prompt security filtering.
projects.architectureOverview: Client requests enter a Next.js App Router edge middleware that checks a cosine-similarity semantic vector cache in Redis before dispatching hybrid retrieval to Qdrant.
keyFeatures: Semantic caching layer reducing duplicate embedding queries by 64%
Hybrid dense (vector) and sparse (BM25) re-ranking with cross-encoders
Real-time PII regex and prompt injection sanitization before model dispatch
Streaming SSE output with deterministic citation tracking
projects.personalContribution: Implemented the semantic cache algorithm, vector indexing pipeline, and Next.js frontend playground.
verifiedOutcomes: Reduced OpenAI monthly API spend by 58%
Achieved average retrieval response time under 180ms
Zero leakage of sensitive internal customer data across 800k queries
projects.challengesLearned: Semantic cache invalidation when underlying documentation changed was solved via document version hashing and inverted vector indexes.
